result.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly skilled Database Developer to join a forward-thinking educational institution in Perth.   This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across SQL Server, integrations, reporting, and application development, with the opportunity to have a real impact on how data is used across the business.  
      This role sits at the heart of the Information and Learning Technologies team, where your technical expertise will directly support both business and academic operations. You will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust data solutions and digital applications that underpin the organisation's strategic goals. This position offers you the chance to work closely with stakeholders across the school community, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable technology outcomes. The role is perfect for someone who thrives in a supportive environment that values knowledge sharing, professional growth, and making a tangible impact on student wellbeing 
 
 Play a key role in shaping data-driven decision-making by developing integrated solutions that enhance accessibility, reporting, and analytics across the institution. 
 Enjoy flexible working opportunities within a collaborative team that values professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 Make a real difference by supporting student wellbeing and academic success through innovative use of technology and data intelligence. 
 
     
  Responsibilities:  
     
 
 Serve as the primary system administrator and subject-matter expert for the key projects, overseeing configuration, user management, data integrity, version upgrades, and module administration. 
 Design, maintain, and optimise database schemas and SQL Server infrastructure to ensure high performance, availability, security, and data quality across all systems. 
 Architect, develop, and manage integrations between core CRM platforms, finance systems, cloud identity providers, and communication tools using APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, and ETL processes. 
 Develop dashboards, reports, self-service analytics tools, and custom queries using platforms like Power BI, Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar to support strategic planning and operational needs. 
 Champion data quality frameworks by implementing profiling, cleansing, validation routines, and advising stakeholders on evidence-based decision-making. 
 Administer database change management processes including updates, release procedures, backup/recovery strategies while ensuring compliance with privacy legislation and organisational policies. 
 Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain custom web applications or internal tools using modern frameworks (Python/.NET/Node.js) aligned with the institution's technology stack. 
 Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments to gather requirements for digital solutions that extend enterprise system capabilities while ensuring secure coding practices are followed. 
 Create comprehensive technical documentation in partnership with key stakeholders; utilise ticketing systems for request tracking; document all changes thoroughly before implementation. 
 
 Mentor IT staff in best practices for database management and application development while staying abreast of emerging technologies. 
 
 
  Requirements:  
 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related discipline is essential for this role. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server technologies including T-SQL scripting, query optimisation techniques as well as experience with SSIS/SSRS or equivalent reporting tools is required. 
 Demonstrated ability to design API-based or middleware integrations (REST/SOAP/webhooks/ETL/Wonde) along with strong skills in ASP.NET/PowerShell/scripting languages is necessary. 
 Solid application development experience using one or more programming languages such as Python/C#/.NET/Node.js/PHP is expected. 
 Proven track record delivering business intelligence solutions using Power BI/Tableau/SSRS/Microsoft Fabric/Crystal Reports or similar platforms is highly valued. 
 Comprehensive understanding of data governance principles including privacy legislation (Australian Privacy Act/APP) plus information security best practices is mandatory. 
 Minimum five years experience in senior database administration or application development roles ideally within education or enterprise environments is preferred. 
 Excellent business analysis skills encompassing risk assessment solution design capabilities coupled with outstanding troubleshooting/problem-solving abilities are vital. 
 Exceptional communication skills enabling clear translation of technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders alongside proven stakeholder engagement experience are important attributes. 
 A positive outlook combined with willingness to embrace organisational values around service/integrity/stewardship plus demonstrated commitment to health & safety policies is expected. 
    Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples are encouraged to apply.  
 To apply please click apply or call  Milena Wawrzyniak-Kalyanpur on +61 8 9266 0980 for a confidential discussion.

result.description:
Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?

To download the PD, and to apply for this job go to: https://janusnet.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies

Applications close 26 July 2026

We are seeking a motivated and analytical ICT Business and Systems Analyst to join our growing team. You will act as the bridge between business needs and technical implementation by gathering requirements, documenting processes, and supporting the successful delivery of ICT projects.

Key Responsibilities

Consult with stakeholders to identify business needs and system requirements.
Analyse current business processes and recommend technology-driven improvements.
Gather, document and validate functional and technical requirements.
Prepare business requirement documents, process maps, user stories and functional specifications.
Work closely with software developers, project managers and third-party vendors to implement solutions.

Assist with system integration, deployment and post-implementation support.
Analyse data and prepare reports to support business decision-making.
Develop user documentation, training materials and standard operating procedures.

Knowledge of business process modelling techniques.
Experience with SQL, databases and reporting tools is desirable.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong documentation and presentation abilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Desirable
Experience with ERP, CRM or enterprise software platforms.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Power BI or business intelligence tools.
Exposure to cloud technologies and API integrations.
Experience within digital transformation or software implementation projects.
What We Offer

Competitive salary package of $80k - 95k

Career development and professional growth opportunities.

Opportunity to work on innovative ICT and digital transformation projects.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day 

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

We're a well-respected not-for-profit that's been serving society's most vulnerable for more than 160 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for the 40,000+ people who rely on our person-centred support. And now, we're extending our reach and impact even further. 

As an Integration Developer, you'll play a key role in delivering secure, scalable and efficient technology solutions that support our mission. You'll be welcomed into a compassionate, respectful and purpose-driven community where we don't just talk about values - we live them. 

Your opportunity 

You will design, develop and maintain enterprise integration solutions that connect Anglicare's systems and services. Working closely with stakeholders across IT, Finance, Payroll, PaC and Facilities, you'll ensure our data flows securely and reliably to support business operations. 

With integrity and resilience, you will: 

Collaborate with business units to gather and document integration requirements 

Develop and maintain Logic App integrations aligned with enterprise architecture and security standards 

Deliver robust, well-tested solutions using Azure services including API Management and Functions 

Monitor and optimise the Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) platform 

Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues, ensuring minimal disruption to services 

Maintain system and data security, including access controls and disaster recovery documentation 

Support stakeholders with integration needs and provide clear, timely communication 

What you'll bring 

You are a detail-oriented, technically capable developer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You bring strong experience in Azure integration technologies and a passion for building secure, scalable solutions. 

You will also need: 

A degree in IT or relevant industry experience 

2+ years' experience working in Azure and developing Logic Apps (or Power Automate) 

Experience with Azure API Management, Azure Functions, REST-SOAP APIs and Postman 

Familiarity with CI-CD pipelines and code repositories 

Strong communication and documentation skills 

Experience integrating with Workday HCM and using Workday Studio (desirable) 

Knowledge of .NET and Azure scripting languages (desirable) 

Why Anglicare? 

We provide meaningful opportunities and choice - for the individuals and communities we support, and for the dedicated people who make it happen. 

At Anglicare, you'll enjoy the security and support of a well-established organisation, while being empowered to shape a rewarding career. You'll belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds. 

Benefits include: 

Flexible work options to support work-life balance 

Salary packaging - up to $15,900 tax-free income, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment 

Ongoing professional development and leadership training 

Discounts at over 400 retailers and access to Fitness Passport 

Employee Assistance Program for you and your family 

Are you ready for a career that means more? 

Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While we are guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds. 

Disclaimer

We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Key Responsibilities:
• Review software requirements and specifications to understand the scope and identify potential areas of concern.
• Develop comprehensive test plans and strategies outlining the objectives, resources, schedule, and scope of testing activities.
• Design and write detailed test cases and test scripts to validate software functionality, performance, and security.
• Conduct manual and automated tests to evaluate the software's performance, identify bugs, and ensure compliance with requirements.
• Document and report identified defects clearly and concisely, providing detailed information to assist developers in reproduction and resolution.
• Perform regression tests to confirm that recent code changes have not adversely affected existing functionalities.
• Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand product features and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
• Develop and maintain automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
• Maintain detailed records of test procedures, test cases, and test results. Prepare reports summarizing testing activities and outcomes.

Qualifications:
• A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field is typically required.
• Minimum 2+ years of experience in manual and automation testing.
• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to think critically and analytically to identify potential issues.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills to articulate test results and collaborate with team members.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and requirements.
• Professional certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) or CSTE (Certified Software Tester) are advantageous.

Job Description
AI Talent is seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to become a key part of our expanding team. In this role, you’ll act as the crucial link between development and operations, driving the automation and optimisation of our deployment processes. You will collaborate with developers to streamline CI/CD pipelines, enhance system reliability, and ensure secure, scalable infrastructure throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Experience:
- Minimum 6 years of full-time experience in a DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Engineering role.
Skills:
- Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for rapid and reliable software delivery.
- Automate software build, test and deployment processes using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
- Monitor system performance, availability and security across environments using industry-standard tools.
- Write and maintain scripts for infrastructure automation and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Bash).
- Collaborate with developers and QA to troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
- Conduct root cause analysis, implement preventative measures, and optimise system processes.
- Maintain detailed technical documentation including deployment guides, monitoring plans and recovery procedures.
- Perform security assessments, manage encryption protocols, and support compliance audits.
- Contribute to the development of internal tools to improve efficiency, system visibility, and automation.
- Drive continuous integration, delivery, and improvement strategies across the SDLC.
Requirements:
- Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
- Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to high standards.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.
- Certified in relevant DevOps or cloud technologies (e.g. AWS, Azure, TOSCA, Kubernetes, ServiceNow Admin).
- Experience with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Selenium, and ServiceNow.
Job Details:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)
